context: Tests whether jpa-persistence maps a Flyway-owned table correctly (sequence allocation, @Version, lazy associations, enum as string, no Lombok), writes a search query that avoids N+1 selects, marks the business rule on the query, keeps ddl-auto at validate, and stops at its layer boundary with a Handover.

checklist.name: Reservation entity in the feature package
checklist.description: A Reservation @Entity is created in a reservation feature package under com.example.hotel, with an explicit no-args constructor and getters, and no Lombok annotation anywhere

checklist.name: Sequence allocation matches the migration
checklist.description: The id uses a @SequenceGenerator for reservation_seq with allocationSize = 1, matching INCREMENT BY 1 and the existing RoomType and Guest entities

checklist.name: Optimistic locking with @Version
checklist.description: The version column is mapped with @Version, and the entity offers no setter for it

checklist.name: Lazy many-to-one associations
checklist.description: guest and roomType are @ManyToOne with fetch = FetchType.LAZY; no association is EAGER

checklist.name: Status as a string enum
checklist.description: status maps to a Java enum with the values CONFIRMED, CHECKED_IN, CANCELLED and @Enumerated(EnumType.STRING), not ORDINAL and not a plain String

checklist.name: Date range query with order
checklist.description: A repository method returns the reservations whose arrival date is between the from and to dates inclusive, ordered by arrival date and then the guest's last name

checklist.name: No N+1 selects
checklist.description: The search loads guest and room type data in the same query: a projection (interface or record constructor expression) joining guest and room type, a join fetch, or an @EntityGraph — not lazy loading per row, and not FetchType.EAGER or open-in-view

checklist.name: Business rule in the query with its marker
checklist.description: The query excludes CANCELLED reservations, and the comment // UC-031 BR-001: stands directly above the query method

checklist.name: Schema stays owned by Flyway
checklist.description: spring.jpa.hibernate.ddl-auto stays validate, open-in-view stays false, and no migration is created or changed

checklist.name: Stops at the layer boundary
checklist.description: No service class, no controller, no API DTO, and no test class is created

checklist.name: Markers table rows added
checklist.description: docs/architecture/stack.md gains Markers rows for Persistence / jpa-persistence, the All row stays, and no other file under docs/ changes

checklist.name: Handover block
checklist.description: The final report ends with a Handover from jpa-persistence (UC-031) block naming the entity, the search method with its signature and return type, and the files, followed by 'Next: /spring-service UC-031'
